Check or suggest study ids

Source: R/registry.R
is_study_id.Rd

Study ids are lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 3-40 characters, usually first author + year (hansen2019, hansen2019b).

Usage

is_study_id(study_id)

check_study_id(study_id)

suggest_study_id(authors, year, path = ".")

Arguments

study_id

Character vector of candidate ids.

authors

Author names (first author first), e.g. "Hansen A".

year

Publication year.

path

Project root, used to avoid ids that are already taken.

Value

is_study_id(): logical vector. check_study_id(): the id, invisibly, or an error.

suggest_study_id(): a free id such as "hansen2019" or "hansen2019b".
